breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructs to use the polar moment of inertia (J) for the Euler buckling calculation. The agent repeated this error in the generated specification by stating, 'Use the polar moment of inertia J = π * d^4 / 32 for the circular section.' The ground truth corrects this by removing the incorrect instruction entirely, as Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment of area (I), not the polar moment.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved this inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly suggested multiplying the critical load by the factor of safety. The agent corrected this by generating the instruction to 'Compute the allowable axial compressive load P_allow as P_cr / n,' which is the correct definition and matches the ground truth prompt.
